description:
Certificates as they were logged, newest first, from a rolling 30-minute window.

This is a live tap, not a search: it answers "what is being issued right now", and there is no way to page backwards through it. A name that was logged an hour ago will not appear. To ask about a specific domain use lookup_domain instead.

Free, no key. Returns at most limit entries from the window; a quiet window returns fewer, never an error. Each call is a fresh snapshot, so two calls a minute apart overlap.

Each entry gives the issuer organisation, the first DNS name on the certificate, and how many names that certificate covers — a high name_count is a shared or wildcard certificate covering many hosts.

limit.description: How many certificates to return, newest first. Default 50 when omitted, maximum 500.

name: recent_certificates
title: Recently logged certificates
